scenario.title: Maintain, refresh and retire a project
situations: A project moves to a new checkout or its repository binding changes.
The installed project layer or registered snapshot needs refresh.
A team retires a project and later restores it.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Which rename/move/rebind operations are actually supported and which must refuse?
Trace preservation and reconciliation rules before teaching a one-command repair.

lessons.title: Maintain the binding without recreating the work
lessons.when: When a checkout moves, a project setting changes, a refresh is needed or the project is retired.
lessons.need: Distinguish local operating-layer removal/refresh from project retirement, repository rebinding and universe deletion; preserve existing work identities and ownership.
lessons.surface: project install/refresh/snapshot; projects get/update/retire/unretire; checkout mapping
lessons.gap: Initial adoption and uninstall are covered elsewhere; ongoing project identity lifecycle is only catalogued here. Review question: should JOURNEYS include moved-checkout, retired-project and stale-layer situations?
